description: One listing in full by its slug (from search_tools): its grade with the score for every category, the reason for each score and the sources it was read from, connection snippets (Claude Code command, MCP client config, x402 example), auth, prices, provenance checks, the tools its hosted MCP endpoint lists, dated changes. Use it when a user asks about one named tool or why it scored what it did. format json (default) and markdown carry the score breakdown with reasons and sources; slim (fewest tokens) leaves it out. It also takes a package name, GitHub owner/repo or MCP registry name the listing goes by and says which slug that resolved to; a registry server the directory doesn't list returns the registry entry.

format.description: json (the default), markdown, or slim for the fewest tokens

slug.description: Listing slug, e.g. exa-mcp, or a name it goes by: a package (@ai-sdk/gateway), a GitHub owner/repo, or a registry server name

name: get_tool
title: Get one listing
